name: FrogButton
description: Triggers an action with semantic variants, sizes, loading feedback, and composable content slots.

accessibility.talkBackNotes: Intended to expose button role, loading state, and disabled behavior. TalkBack, label grouping, localization, and actual touch bounds require verification before stability.

properties.name: onClick
properties.description: Callback triggered when the button is clicked by touch, keyboard, or accessibility action.

properties.name: modifier
properties.description: Layout modifier applied to the outer touch-target container.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual semantic variant: Primary, Secondary, Outline, Ghost, or Destructive.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Dimensional scale: Small (32dp), Medium (40dp), or Large (48dp).

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Controls interaction state. When false, clicks are suppressed and visual style becomes muted.

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Replaces visible content with a centered progress indicator while preserving measured label and slot bounds. Exposes Loading state and suppresses activation.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: Corner radius shape applied to button background and border.

properties.name: colors
properties.description: Resolved colors across enabled, disabled, pressed, and focused states.

properties.name: border
properties.description: Optional stroke border applied to button boundary.

properties.name: contentPadding
properties.description: Internal spacing between button boundary and content row.

properties.name: interactionSource
properties.description: Interaction stream driving press animations and focus rings.

properties.name: leadingIcon
properties.description: Optional slot rendered before the button label.

properties.name: trailingIcon
properties.description: Optional slot rendered after the button label.

properties.name: fullWidth
properties.description: Fills the available horizontal width of the button surface and touch target.

properties.name: content
properties.description: The button label or custom row content.

examples.title: Primary Action
examples.description: High-emphasis action for the primary task on the screen.

examples.title: Secondary Action
examples.description: Tonal zinc surface for alternative operations.

examples.title: Outlined Action
examples.description: Transparent surface with structural Zinc border.

examples.title: Ghost Action
examples.description: Flat low-emphasis button for toolbars and compact surfaces.

examples.title: Loading State
examples.description: Displays inline circular progress indicator and pauses user interaction.

examples.title: Leading icon
examples.description: Run an action with a decorative leading icon.

examples.title: Trailing icon
examples.description: Indicate progression with a decorative trailing icon.

examples.title: Disabled action
examples.description: An unavailable action exposes disabled semantics.
